ops.title: Automate plugin.json version bump in the release flow
ops.description: `captain_hook/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` `version` gates what consumer plugin caches resolve; it sat at 9.10.0 through six PyPI releases (9.11.0–9.16.0 never reached consumers — cache frozen at commit ea58be34, 2026-07-11) until hand-bumped to 9.16.0 in `01e7ac21`. The tag-driven release workflow (`release-pypi.yml`) takes the version from the tag but never touches plugin.json. Wire the bump into the release path — e.g. a release-workflow step that syncs plugin.json to the tag and commits back, or a pre-tag check that fails the release when plugin.json lags the tag.

ops.text: Cutting a v* release leaves captain_hook/.claude-plugin/plugin.json version equal to the released version without a manual bump, or the release fails loudly when it would lag
